summary: Frontend-only verification of the new POPUP MODAL behavior for teacher analytics. Logged in as test_teacher_1 (via /api/auth/login with {identifier, password}) and seeded session_token cookie + localStorage. (1) Homework analytics popup: On teacher-dashboard > Demo Class, Homework(2) cards render compact (title + type badge + due date + X/Y done + green progress bar) with an Analytics button and trash icon. NO inline student list is present before clicking. Clicking [data-testid=homework-analytics-btn-hw_ae13b88455b0] opens a centered Radix Dialog [data-testid=homework-analytics-dialog] titled 'Homework Analytics: Testing' with 3 class-level tiles (Done / Not done / Completion%) and the per-student list [data-testid=homework-student-list] inside the dialog. Same works for the Candy Shop (activity) homework – dialog shows 'auto-tracked' hint. Escape (and backdrop) close the dialog. Remove-homework icon confirms and deletes (verified icon presence + prior iteration coverage — not re-triggered to preserve seed data). (2) Activity analytics popup on Topic page (topic_cdac2568de6f) has 3 activity content cards (Shopping at mela, Shopping at super market, Candy Shop). No inline activity-scores-* elements present for the teacher role (parent-only ActivityScoresBadge is properly gated). Each card shows [data-testid=activity-analytics-btn-<content_id>]. Clicking opens a centered Radix Dialog [data-testid=activity-analytics-dialog] titled 'Activity Analytics: Shopping at mela' containing 4 summary tiles (Students / Completed / Not attempted / Avg score), a completion progress bar, Completed list and Not Attempted list with [data-testid=analytics-pending-<student_id>] rows. Escape closes. (3) Button color distinction on Topic page confirmed visually (orange 'Assign as Homework' vs blue 'Assigned as Homework' on the Candy Shop card as prior iteration). All required data-testids are present and correctly named. No console errors captured during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: TeacherHomework.jsx openAnalytics does not guard against a stale response when the user rapidly clicks multiple Analytics buttons — the last-arriving fetch will overwrite `detail` even if the user switched to a different card in the meantime. Consider tracking activeHw.homework_id in a ref and discarding stale responses.

ActivityAnalyticsDialog fetches inside a useEffect keyed on [open, contentId] but never AbortController-cancels the in-flight axios request on close/unmount. Low-impact but could produce a spurious toast if the request errors after the dialog is closed.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing homework records hw_ae13b88455b0 (Testing/Video) and hw_c63a55c16008 (Candy Shop/Activity) and existing topic topic_cdac2568de6f content items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login body must be {identifier, password} (not username_or_email). After POST /api/auth/login, seed session_token to BOTH localStorage AND context cookie because the Partitioned cookie set by the server is dropped by Playwright chromium. Teacher dashboard route is /teacher-dashboard (NOT /teacher — /teacher gives 'No routes matched'). Topic containing seeded activity content: topic_cdac2568de6f (3 activity items). Homework dialog testid: homework-analytics-dialog; activity dialog testid: activity-analytics-dialog.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found. Feature works as specified: analytics are now popup modals (Radix Dialog centered overlay with role=dialog) and inline student/score lists are no longer rendered under teacher cards by default.
